subject: Provisional observability subprocessor swap - impact and approval
messages:
From: Marina Lopez <marina.lopez@fintrust.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary subprocessor substitution for observability pipeline - cert rotation

Hi Kimberly,

Quick heads up from FinTrust infrastructure team: our current observability vendor (LogWave) is performing an emergency certificate rotation for a subset of EU collectors on July 9–10. During the rotation they will route telemetry through a vetted temporary processor, EdgeSight, for 24–36 hours to avoid ingestion gaps.

We understand this is a short-lived substitution; EdgeSight will only receive parsed logs/metrics (no raw user payloads), retain data for max 7 days, and will be bound by the same DPA terms per our contract clause 4.2. Attaching the proposed addendum and a preliminary processor inventory (CSV).

Could you confirm whether Redwood needs any specific evidence or a formal signoff to allow EdgeSight to process logs temporarily? Also flag if there's anything on retention/KMS we should tighten for this window.

Thanks,
Marina Lopez
Head of Cloud Ops — FinTrust

Attachments: fintrust-edgesight-addendum.pdf, edge-sight-processor-inventory.csv

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Temporary subprocessor substitution for observability pipeline - cert rotation

Forwarding FinTrust's notice — they want to route during a cert rotation to EdgeSight for ~24–36h. Attachments they sent are the addendum + a processor inventory.

Ask: quick risk check + can we approve under an expedited path? Markus — can you confirm technical exposure (PII/keys) and whether EdgeSight's retention/KMS posture is acceptable. Laura — please review the addendum and confirm if we need a one-off DPA clause or a short addendum signature. Mina — PSA for CS/Account team so we align on messaging.

I think timeframe is tight (rotation starts July 9). I'll propose conditional approval if SOC2 evidence and confirmation of no persistent KV cache.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Manager, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: mina.haddad@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Temporary subprocessor substitution for observability pipeline - cert rotation

Kim — quick technical read: EdgeSight will receive parsed logs and metrics at the collector level. Per their inventory, they do not ingest request bodies or full user content; we need to confirm that our app-level structured logs don't contain unredacted PII.

Immediate asks from infra/security perspective:
- SOC2 Type II report for EdgeSight (or SSAE attestation) — must be current.
- Confirm KMS boundary: temporary keys must not be imported into EdgeSight; logs should be transmitted over TLS only and indexed with hashed IDs if possible.
- No KV cache of full-session transcripts; if there is a KV/cache we require auto-ttl <= 48 hours and audit logging enabled.

If those three are confirmed, risk is low for a short window. Recommend conditional approval with documented exceptions and an internal rollback plan. I can add a note for the rollout runbook.

-Markus
Principal Infra Engineer

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Temporary subprocessor substitution for observability pipeline - cert rotation

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed FinTrust's proposed addendum. Two high‑priority edits before we sign off:

1) Add explicit clause that EdgeSight is only permitted to process aggregated/parsed telemetry and must not reconstruct raw request bodies or store identifiable payloads.
2) Insert an audit evidence clause: EdgeSight must provide SOC2 Type II (last 12 months) and a signed attestation that no data is egressed to third parties during the window.

If they can provide a SOC2 PDF and confirm the auto-ttl/caching behavior in writing, we can approve via our delegated security approvals process. I've drafted a one‑paragraph addendum (attached) we can send back as a DocuSign.

Attachment: DPA-addendum.pdf

-Laur a Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: Marina Lopez <marina.lopez@fintrust.com>, legal@fintrust.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary subprocessor substitution for observability pipeline - cert rotation

Hi Marina — thanks for the notice and materials. We can provisionally approve EdgeSight as a temporary subprocessor for the July 9–10 rotation under the following conditions:

1) FinTrust or EdgeSight provides SOC2 Type II report (latest 12 months) and a signed attestation that no data egress to third parties will occur during the window.
2) EdgeSight confirms in writing that no raw request bodies or unredacted PII will be indexed; any potential IDs must be hashed and auto-ttl configured to <= 48 hours.
3) DPA addendum signed (we attached a one‑paragraph addendum for DocuSign) before the rotation begins.

Please share the SOC2 PDF and return the signed addendum. Once received, we'll notify our SRE team to allow the temporary routing and we'll publish a short customer-facing note if needed.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/finish/ABC123-def-subprocessor-addendum
Runbook (internal): https://app.redwood.com/secure/ops/runbooks/OBS_CERT_ROTATION

Best,
Kim

Attachment: DPA-addendum.pdf

From: Marina Lopez <marina.lopez@fintrust.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ops@edgesight.io
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary subprocessor substitution for observability pipeline - cert rotation

Kim / Laura — appreciate the quick turnaround. EdgeSight has uploaded their SOC2 Type II (link below) and confirmed the auto-ttl/hashed-ID behavior; their legal team will sign the addendum via DocuSign today. I'll send the SOC2 PDF once I have permission to share (it may be redacted in parts).

SOC2 link (internal to EdgeSight): https://edgesight.io/soc2/fintrust-observability (they will send the PDF)

We plan to proceed with the rotation July 9 22:00 UTC with a 24h window. I'll update you if anything changes.

-Marina
Head of Cloud Ops — FinTrust
